# SpecForge Monetization Plan

## Recommended model

Keep SpecForge Core free and open source.

Monetize the workflow around it:

- SpecForge Pro backend
- Hosted web app
- Repo drift checks
- Export integrations
- Team review workflows
- Industry-specific packs
- Custom setup and audits

## Why not sell the skill pack only

A skill pack is easy to copy. The stronger product is the hosted workflow, integrations, review system, and maintained templates.

## Core promise

Core should always let a user generate strong app planning docs without paying.

## Pro promise

Pro should save time for serious users by adding automation, persistence, collaboration, integrations, scheduled checks, and higher-quality reports.

## Possible pricing

- Core: free
- Pro Solo: low monthly or annual plan
- Pro Team: per-seat or workspace plan
- Repo audit service: one-time paid service
- Agency or startup setup: custom pricing

Do not price before testing with real users. Start with a small group and measure whether the tool saves enough time to justify payment.
